findings.message: <section id="scene-1"> has timing attributes but no class="clip". The runtime still hides it outside its time range, but Studio and the GSAP clip-ownership rules use .clip to recognise a clip, so leaving it off makes the element harder to edit and to lint.
findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.

findings.message: <section id="scene-1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section id="scene-1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
